import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/home/appontrack/public_html/mobile/updates/native")
p=root/"latest.json"
assert p.is_file(),"NATIVE_LATEST_NOT_FOUND"
manifest=json.loads(p.read_bytes());meta=json.loads(manifest["payload"])
target=root/meta["file"];assert target.is_file(),"NATIVE_APK_NOT_FOUND"
h=hashlib.sha256();size=0
with target.open("rb") as f:
    while True:
        b=f.read(262144)
        if not b:break
        size+=len(b);h.update(b)
assert size==meta["size"] and h.hexdigest()==meta["sha256"],"APK_CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH"
print(json.dumps({"status":"verified_on_host","version_code":meta["version_code"],"version_name":meta["version_name"],"bytes":size,"sha256":h.hexdigest(),"file_exists":True,"latest_manifest_exists":True,"path":"mobile/updates/native/"}))
